answer: Standing is a trellis of tranches, each unlocked by a different verified contribution: original answers, accurate grading, outside delivery. A tranche opens only when a beacon-drawn auditor confirms that work; weight is the min across tranches, not the sum. A farm producing one cheap signal maxes one tranche but stays pinned at the minimum, unable to grade well and win real counterparties per alias. Each proof is non-transferable and decays without renewal, so clones cannot pool a mature trellis. A violet audit lists each tranche vector. Cost scales with breadth of real capability, not keys.
